tweak.title: Foreground priority boost
tweak.why: Short, variable quanta with a 3:1 foreground boost so the game thread gets CPU back sooner.

tweak.title: Disable core parking
tweak.why: Keeps every core unparked so the game thread never waits on a core wake-up.

tweak.title: Minimum processor state 100%
tweak.why: Stops clocks dropping between frames. Costs idle power and heat.

tweak.title: Turbo boost: aggressive
tweak.why: Makes sure turbo is enabled and ramps quickly. Some optimizers turn it off, which costs a lot of fps on a 4-core CPU.

tweak.title: Shallow C-states during play
tweak.why: Biases the CPU towards shallow idle states to cut wake-up latency.

tweak.title: Disable processor idle
tweak.why: Keeps cores spinning instead of idling. Large heat and power cost; only helps on some systems.

tweak.title: Multimedia scheduler: games task
tweak.why: Gives the MMCSS 'Games' task high scheduling and GPU priority.

tweak.title: MMCSS system responsiveness 10%
tweak.why: Reserves less CPU for background tasks while multimedia work runs. 0 is clamped to 20 by Windows, so 10 is the real minimum.

tweak.title: Disable power throttling
tweak.why: Stops Windows putting background processes (voice chat, overlays) on efficiency scheduling.

tweak.title: Multimedia scheduler: games I/O priority
tweak.why: Gives disk reads from MMCSS 'Games' threads high I/O priority.

tweak.title: Multimedia scheduler: no idle detection
tweak.why: Undocumented MMCSS values that keep its scheduling boost active instead of waiting for idle periods. Results vary by PC; benchmark before keeping.

tweak.title: Use TSC, not forced HPET
tweak.why: Forcing HPET routes every QueryPerformanceCounter call through a slow timer and raises frametime variance.

tweak.title: Default platform tick
tweak.why: useplatformtick forces the legacy tick source; the default is better on Kaby Lake and newer.

tweak.title: Disable dynamic tick
tweak.why: Keeps the system timer ticking at a fixed rate. Raises idle power.

tweak.title: Enhanced TSC sync policy
tweak.why: Uses the enhanced TSC synchronization policy at boot.

tweak.title: Allow global timer resolution
tweak.why: Windows 11 makes timer resolution per-process. This lets the 0.5 ms request from graze-tune apply to games too.

tweak.title: MSI mode on the GPU
tweak.why: Message-signaled interrupts avoid shared line interrupts and cut DPC latency.

tweak.title: MSI mode on the network adapter
tweak.why: Same as for the GPU; the I219-LM supports MSI.

tweak.title: High interrupt priority for the GPU
tweak.why: Marks GPU interrupts high priority so they are serviced before storage and USB.

tweak.title: Move GPU interrupts off CPU 0
tweak.why: CPU 0 also services network and USB. Pins nvlddmkm interrupts to CPU 2.

tweak.title: Workstation file cache
tweak.why: LargeSystemCache=1 is a server setting that starves games of working set.

tweak.title: Keep kernel in RAM
tweak.why: DisablePagingExecutive keeps drivers and kernel code resident. Safe with 16 GB.

tweak.title: SysMain on demand
tweak.why: Superfetch prefetching causes disk and CPU bursts on 4-thread CPUs. Manual start keeps it available.

tweak.title: Disable boot and app prefetcher
tweak.why: Avoids prefetch reads competing with game asset streaming on SATA SSDs.

tweak.title: TRIM enabled
tweak.why: Without TRIM, SSD writes slow down over time and cause load stutter.

tweak.title: Disable last-access timestamps
tweak.why: Skips a metadata write on every file read.

tweak.title: Disable 8.3 short names
tweak.why: Stops NTFS generating legacy short names for new files.

tweak.title: Never spin down / idle the disk
tweak.why: Avoids link power wake-up hitches when a game streams assets.

tweak.title: AHCI link power: active
tweak.why: Keeps the SATA link out of partial/slumber states.

tweak.title: Low Latency Mode: Ultra
tweak.why: Just-in-time frame submission. Only helps when GPU-bound; on a CPU-bound i5-7500 benchmark it.

tweak.title: Vertical sync: force off
tweak.why: Removes vsync queueing. Pair with G-SYNC and a frame cap if you have VRR.

tweak.title: Power management: prefer maximum performance
tweak.why: Stops the GPU dropping clocks between frames, which shows up as frametime spikes.

tweak.title: Shader cache size: unlimited
tweak.why: Avoids shader recompiles (and their stutter) when the default cache fills.

tweak.title: Texture filtering: high performance
tweak.why: Small fps gain, slightly blurrier textures at an angle.

tweak.title: Threaded optimization: on
tweak.why: Offloads OpenGL driver work to another thread. Auto is usually right; on for OpenGL games.

tweak.title: Preferred refresh rate: highest available
tweak.why: Makes fullscreen games use the monitor's highest refresh rate.

tweak.title: MSI mode on the RTX 3050
tweak.why: Message-signaled interrupts for the GPU. Same change as in Interrupts & drivers.

tweak.title: Disable NVIDIA telemetry container
tweak.why: Removes a background service that wakes periodically.

tweak.title: Disable HDCP
tweak.why: Removes HDCP handshakes on display mode changes. Breaks protected streaming video.

tweak.title: PCIe link power management off
tweak.why: Keeps the GPU's PCIe link at full power so it doesn't retrain between frames.

tweak.title: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweak.why: Lets the GPU manage its own queue. Required for DLSS frame generation; benchmark on older CPUs.

tweak.title: Disable multiplane overlay
tweak.why: MPO causes flicker and stutter on some NVIDIA drivers with mixed monitors.

tweak.title: Optimizations for windowed games
tweak.why: Uses flip-model presentation for DX10/11 windowed games: lower latency, allows VRR.

tweak.title: Keep fullscreen optimizations on
tweak.why: Disabling FSO globally is a common placebo tweak; with FSO games get independent flip anyway.

tweak.title: Disable USB selective suspend
tweak.why: Stops Windows suspending idle USB devices, which can drop the first mouse movement.

tweak.title: Disable pointer acceleration
tweak.why: 1:1 mouse movement in menus and games that use the Windows cursor.

tweak.title: Default mouse data queue
tweak.why: Shrinking MouseDataQueueSize is a placebo at best and drops input at high polling rates; keep the default 100.

tweak.title: Disable sticky/filter key shortcuts
tweak.why: Stops Shift x5 popping a dialog over the game.

tweak.title: Shortest key repeat delay
tweak.why: Held keys start repeating after the shortest delay, at the fastest rate.

tweak.title: Disable toggle keys shortcut
tweak.why: Holding Num Lock for five seconds no longer opens the Toggle Keys prompt mid-game.

tweak.title: Disable communications ducking
tweak.why: Stops Windows lowering game audio when voice chat opens a communications stream.

tweak.title: MMCSS audio task priority
tweak.why: Keeps audio processing ahead of background work so it doesn't crackle under load.

tweak.title: Disable multimedia network throttling
tweak.why: Removes the 10 packets/ms cap MMCSS applies to non-multimedia traffic while audio plays.

tweak.title: NIC interrupt moderation off
tweak.why: Delivers packets immediately instead of batching them. Slightly higher CPU use.

tweak.title: Disable Energy Efficient Ethernet
tweak.why: EEE puts the link to sleep between packets and adds wake latency.

tweak.title: Disable flow control
tweak.why: Stops pause frames from the switch stalling the receive path.

tweak.title: Default QoS bandwidth reserve
tweak.why: 'Free 20% bandwidth' tweaks are placebo: Windows only reserves bandwidth for apps that ask for it.

tweak.title: No peer-to-peer update sharing
tweak.why: Delivery Optimization uploads Windows updates to other PCs, which eats upload bandwidth and raises ping. Updates still download from Microsoft.

tweak.title: Disable smart multi-homed name resolution
tweak.why: Windows otherwise sends each DNS query out every adapter at once, which can bypass a VPN or a chosen DNS server.

tweak.title: Game Mode on
tweak.why: Game Mode stops Windows Update installs and driver installs while you play. Some optimizers turn it off.

tweak.title: Disable Game DVR background recording
tweak.why: Background recording encodes the last minutes of play continuously.

tweak.title: Disable transparency effects
tweak.why: Less DWM blur work while alt-tabbed or using a borderless game.

tweak.title: Silence toast notifications
tweak.why: Toasts can knock a fullscreen game out of independent flip.

tweak.title: Instant menus
tweak.why: Removes the 400 ms menu show delay.

tweak.title: Telemetry: required only
tweak.why: Lowers diagnostic data collection and the DiagTrack uploads that come with it.

tweak.title: Connected User Experiences on demand
tweak.why: DiagTrack wakes periodically to upload telemetry.

tweak.title: Block background Store apps
tweak.why: Stops Store apps running in the background.

tweak.title: Disable compatibility appraiser task
tweak.why: Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser scans every program and spikes CPU for minutes.

tweak.title: Windows Search on demand
tweak.why: The indexer competes for disk and CPU after installs and patches. Start menu search still works, only slower.

tweak.title: Xbox services on demand
tweak.why: Starts Xbox Live services only when an Xbox app asks for them.

tweak.title: Windows Update on (manual trigger)
tweak.why: Disabling Windows Update breaks driver and security updates; Game Mode already pauses installs while you play.

tweak.title: No startup app delay
tweak.why: Removes Explorer's artificial delay before starting startup apps.

tweak.title: Fast shutdown of hung apps
tweak.why: Closes apps that hang at shutdown instead of waiting.

tweak.title: Cut taskbar and desktop animations
tweak.why: Turns off taskbar animations, icon label shadows and Aero Peek, so DWM has less to draw over a borderless game.

tweak.title: Local-only Start search
tweak.why: Start search stops sending every keystroke to Bing and shows only apps, files and settings, which also makes it faster.

tweak.title: No promoted items in Start
tweak.why: Hides app and tip promotions from the Recommended section of Start.

tweak.title: Turn off Widgets
tweak.why: The Widgets board keeps a WebView process alive and refreshes news and weather in the background.

tweak.title: End task in the taskbar menu
tweak.why: Adds End task to a taskbar button's right-click menu, so a frozen game can be killed without Task Manager.

tweak.title: Disable Customer Experience tasks
tweak.why: The CEIP consolidator and USB reporting tasks collect and upload usage data on a schedule.

tweak.title: Disable app compatibility scan tasks
tweak.why: PcaPatchDbTask, MareBackup and StartupAppTask scan installed programs in the background and can spike disk and CPU.

tweak.title: Disable feedback data tasks
tweak.why: The Feedback Hub DmClient tasks gather diagnostics for feedback scenarios on a timer.

tweak.title: Turn off Windows Error Reporting
tweak.why: Crashes are no longer packaged and uploaded, which can take seconds of disk and CPU after a game crash. Crash dumps for your own debugging are lost too.

tweak.title: Disable disk diagnostic data collector
tweak.why: Stops the scheduled task that gathers disk health data for Microsoft. SMART warnings still show.

tweak.title: Stop diagnostic trace sessions at boot
tweak.why: These ETW trace sessions log telemetry and diagnostics from boot onward. Network and diagnostic troubleshooters lose their history.

tweak.title: Disable WAP push message routing
tweak.why: dmwappushservice only routes device-management push messages, which a home PC never gets. Leave it on if work or school manages this PC.

tweak.title: Downloaded Maps Manager on demand
tweak.why: Only the Maps app needs it.

tweak.title: Distributed Link Tracking on demand
tweak.why: Tracks shortcuts to files that move between NTFS volumes on a network domain; a home PC has no use for it running all the time.

tweak.title: Program Compatibility Assistant on demand
tweak.why: Watches every program you start for compatibility problems.

tweak.title: Connected Devices Platform on demand
tweak.why: Runs Phone Link, Nearby sharing and cross-device sync. Starts when those features ask, so they can feel slower to connect.

tweak.title: Print Spooler on demand
tweak.why: Saves a background service on PCs that never print. If printing stops working, turn this back off.

tweak.title: Disable AllJoyn Router
tweak.why: AllJoyn is a retired smart-home protocol.

tweak.title: Disable Retail Demo
tweak.why: Only used by store display PCs.

tweak.title: Disable Fax
tweak.why: Nobody on a gaming PC sends faxes.

tweak.title: Disable Fast Startup
tweak.why: Fast Startup resumes the kernel and drivers from a hibernation file, so driver and timer changes only take effect after a real restart. Off gives a clean start every boot.

tweak.title: Disable VBS / memory integrity
tweak.why: Removes the hypervisor from the gaming path (5-10% on 7th-gen Intel). Weakens kernel protection; Valorant, FACEIT and some others require it.

tweak.title: Disable Spectre/Meltdown mitigations
tweak.why: Large syscall-cost win on Kaby Lake. Exposes you to cross-process data leaks from untrusted code.

tweak.title: Don't launch the hypervisor
tweak.why: Turns off Hyper-V at boot. Breaks WSL2, Windows Sandbox and some emulators (MuMuPlayer has a non-Hyper-V mode).

tweak.title: Turn off Recall snapshots
tweak.why: Recall screenshots the desktop every few seconds and runs on-device analysis on them, which costs disk writes and NPU/CPU time during play.

tweak.title: Turn off Click to Do
tweak.why: Click to Do reads whatever is on screen to suggest actions. Off by policy for this PC and this user.

tweak.title: Turn off Windows Copilot
tweak.why: Removes the Copilot sidebar and its taskbar button. The Copilot app from the Store is not touched.

tweak.title: Turn off the advertising ID
tweak.why: Apps can no longer read a per-user ID to target ads across apps.

tweak.title: No tips based on diagnostic data
tweak.why: Stops Windows using your diagnostic data to pick tips, ads and recommendations.

tweak.title: Stop promoted apps installing themselves
tweak.why: Windows quietly installs sponsored Store apps and games after updates. This stops new ones; apps already installed stay.

tweak.title: Hide tips and suggestions
tweak.why: Turns off suggested content in Settings and Start, 'get even more out of Windows' tips and the lock screen facts.

tweak.title: No Microsoft account and setup nags
tweak.why: Removes the Microsoft 365 and account banners in Settings and the 'finish setting up your PC' screen after updates.

tweak.title: Turn off activity history
tweak.why: Stops Windows recording which apps and files you open and uploading that history.

tweak.title: Turn off location services
tweak.why: No app can read your location. Automatic time zone, Weather and Find My Device stop working.

tweak.title: No automatic offline map downloads
tweak.why: Stops the Maps task downloading map updates in the background.

tweak.title: Stop collecting typing and inking data
tweak.why: Windows otherwise builds a personal dictionary from what you type and write and can read your contacts for it.

tweak.title: Turn off online speech recognition
tweak.why: Voice input stops going to Microsoft's cloud service. Voice typing falls back to the offline engine where one is installed.

tweak.title: No feedback prompts
tweak.why: Stops 'how likely are you to recommend Windows' pop-ups, which can steal focus from a game.

tweak.title: Stop tracking app launches
tweak.why: Windows stops counting which apps you start. Start loses its 'most used' list.

tweak.title: Keep the PC name out of diagnostics
tweak.why: Diagnostic data is sent without this PC's name.

tweak.title: Hide your language list from websites
tweak.why: Websites can no longer read the list of languages installed on this PC.

audit.title: Platform clock forced to HPET
audit.why: Forces every QueryPerformanceCounter call through HPET. Adds ~0.5-1 µs per call and raises frametime variance.

audit.title: LargeSystemCache enabled
audit.why: Server cache policy. The file cache grows at the expense of the game's working set.

audit.title: TRIM disabled
audit.why: SSD write performance degrades over time and load times stutter.

audit.title: Windows Update service disabled
audit.why: No driver or security updates. Game Mode already pauses installs during play.

audit.title: Turbo boost disabled
audit.why: Locks the i5-7500 at 3.4 GHz instead of 3.8 GHz.

audit.title: Game Mode disabled
audit.why: Without Game Mode, Windows Update and driver installs can run mid-game.

audit.title: Win32PrioritySeparation changed
audit.why: Several tools write different values here; the last one wins. Benchmark 0x26 vs 0x2A and keep one.

audit.title: Mouse data queue shrunk
audit.why: No measurable latency change; very small values drop input at 1000 Hz+.

audit.title: QoS bandwidth limit set to 0
audit.why: Windows only reserves bandwidth for apps that request QoS. No effect on games.

audit.title: TcpAckFrequency / TCPNoDelay set
audit.why: Nagle tweaks only affect TCP; nearly every competitive game uses UDP. Set per-interface, not here.

audit.title: Service host split threshold changed
audit.why: Groups services into fewer svchost processes. Saves a little RAM, no fps or latency effect.

audit.title: VBS / memory integrity disabled
audit.why: A real speed-up on older Intel, but weakens kernel protection and some anti-cheats refuse to run.
